did: I answered your ask about the two admin epics the way you said, by folding the older one into the administration epic. Its list of knobs, its open stories and your two open questions moved there. Then I built the limits on the phone's Settings pages. Each page now lists what that part of the app keeps, how much of it is kept right now, and what happens at the limit. That covers reflections, every kind of take, word sets, Jobs, the voice notes on their way home and the failure log. A test fails if a new limit appears in the code without a row there. Two review passes caught two rows that described their limit wrongly, and I fixed both. Last, I mapped every place that still drops or forgets something without a word, for the next story.

calls.title: Soundbites and Studio's takes keep their counts on their own screens
options: only on their own screens, beside the recorder
a row on Settings › This phone as well
calls.why: Each already says how many it holds where you record, and reading them from Settings would mean reaching into Studio's own store.
calls.undo: Add a row for each in the phone's limits list and take them off its not-shown list.

left: SM3, saying out loud whenever something is dropped or not kept, isn't built. It spans about six stores in four packages. Its issue now lists each one and a way to split the work.
SM4, home's limits the phone can't see, isn't started. It needs a server route first.
